whenToUse: Local business sites where call, directions and WhatsApp are the main conversions (restaurant, spa, clinic).
A sticky mobile action bar plus a floating message button on desktop.
avoidWhen: SaaS or B2B sites where a form is the primary path — use CTA or Contact form.
a11y: Each action is a labelled link (tel:, maps, wa.me) with text, not icon-only.
The bar must not cover the page footer or focused content; content gets bottom padding.
